# OpenBB Docs - odp/python

## Docs

- [Architecture](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/concepts/architecture): How openbb-core turns installed extensions into the Python Interface and the REST API, and how a command call moves through routers, providers, and the OBBject envelope.

- [Extension types](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/concepts/extensions): The four kinds of openbb-core extensions (router, provider, OBBject, and charting), the entry-point group each ships under, and what the entry point must resolve to.

- [Concepts](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/concepts/index): How openbb-core is put together: the two interfaces, the OBBject envelope, extension types, streaming, and the generated Python package.

- [The OBBject envelope](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/concepts/obbject): OBBject is the return type used across openbb-core. Its fields, conversion methods, and how the output_type preference applies them.

- [Packaging and static assets](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/concepts/packaging): How the openbb Python package is generated from installed extensions, when it rebuilds on its own, and when to run openbb-build.

- [Streaming responses](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/concepts/streaming): Streaming commands yield typed rows from a provider's async iterator. The Python Interface returns an OBBStream handle and the REST API returns a text/event-stream response.

- [Adoption Of Genetically Engineered Crops In The United States](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AdoptionOfGeneticallyEngineeredCropsInTheUnitedStates): Get ERS adoption of genetically engineered crops - the annual share of planted acres in genetically engineered corn, upland cotton, and soybean varieties, by trait and by State, pivoted to a wide layout with the GE traits as columns and years as rows
- [Agricultural And Food Rd Expenditures](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AgriculturalAndFoodRdExpenditures): Get ERS agricultural and food research and development (R&D) expenditures - public and private U
- [Agricultural Exchange Rates](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AgriculturalExchangeRates): Get ERS agricultural exchange rates - real and nominal commodity trade-weighted exchange rate indexes and bilateral local-currency-per-USD rates, each pivoted to a wide layout with time in the rows and the commodity (index tables) or partner country (bilateral tables) in the columns
- [Agricultural Productivity](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AgriculturalProductivity): Get ERS agricultural productivity - the farm output, input, and total factor productivity indices for the United States and the relative productivity levels of the 48 contiguous States, each pivoted to a wide layout with the series as columns and years as rows
- [Agricultural Trade Multipliers](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AgriculturalTradeMultipliers): Get ERS agricultural trade multipliers - producer- and port-level output and employment multipliers per commodity, with export value, in a wide layout
- [Area And Road Ruggedness Scales](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AreaAndRoadRuggednessScales): Get ERS area and road ruggedness scales - census-tract Area Ruggedness Scale (ARS) and Road Ruggedness Scale (RRS) classifications with terrain ruggedness statistics, rurality, and population, as a single-vintage geographic lookup table scoped by State
- [Available Ecb Indicators](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AvailableEcbIndicators): Search the ECB SDMX catalogue of dataflows
- [Available Imf Indicators](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AvailableImfIndicators): Search the IMF SDMX indicator catalog by query, dataflow, or keyword
- [Available Oecd Indicators](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/AvailableOecdIndicators): Search the OECD SDMX catalogue for indicators across all dataflows
- [Bls Ces Confidence Intervals](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/BlsCesConfidenceIntervals): CES Analytical Tables A-C2 — 90% confidence intervals for employment, hours, and earnings
- [Bls Ces Table 1](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/BlsCesTable1): CES Analytical Table 1 — employment normal seasonal movements, OTM changes, significance
- [Bls Ces Table 2](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/BlsCesTable2): CES Analytical Table 2 — detailed industries ranked by over-the-month change

- [Bls Ces Table 5](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/BlsCesTable5): CES Analytical Table 5 — average weekly hours and average hourly earnings changes
- [Bls Ces Table 6](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/BlsCesTable6): CES Analytical Table 6 — aggregate weekly hours and payroll changes
- [Bls Ces Table 7](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/BlsCesTable7): CES Analytical Table 7 — most recent employment peak/trough and changes
- [Bls Cpi Average Prices](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/data_models/BlsCpiAveragePrices): BLS Consumer Price Index chart — Average Price Data, Selected Items

- [Country Input](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/country_input): Accept country names, ISO 3166 codes, or snake_case names in a provider's parameters and normalize them with the Country type.
- [Deprecating Endpoints](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/deprecating_endpoints): Mark a router command as deprecated with OpenBBDeprecationWarning so Python callers get a warning and the OpenAPI schema flags the route.
- [Disabling Output Validation](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/disabling_output_validation): Turn off response validation for a router command with no_validate=True, and what changes in the REST API and the Python Interface.
- [Dynamic Command Execution](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/dynamic_command_execution): Run OpenBB commands by route with CommandRunner, without the generated obb package, for services and tools that choose commands at runtime.
- [Function Examples](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/examples): Add APIEx and PythonEx usage examples to router commands for generated docstrings, the OpenAPI schema, and the reference docs.
- [Exchange Input](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/exchange_input): Accept exchange MICs, acronyms, or names in a provider's parameters and normalize them to ISO 10383 codes with the Exchange type.
- [HTTP Requests](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/http_requests): Make synchronous and asynchronous HTTP requests in fetchers with the openbb-core helpers, which apply the user's proxy, certificate, and timeout settings.

- [Validators](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/developer/how-to/validators): Use Pydantic field and model validators in QueryParams and Data models to parse dates, normalize percents, set dynamic defaults, and clean source values.

- [REST API](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/quickstart/rest_api): Serve the installed OpenBB Python V5 commands as a FastAPI REST API with openbb-api or any ASGI server, then add authentication, CORS, and HTTPS.

- [food_availability_per_capita](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/food_availability_per_capita): Get ERS Food Availability (Per Capita) Data System - per capita food supply, loss-adjusted availability, and nutrient availability of the U
- [food_consumption_nutrient_intakes_and_diet_quality](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/food_consumption_nutrient_intakes_and_diet_quality): Get ERS food consumption, nutrient intakes, and diet quality - U

- [food_security_in_the_united_states](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/food_security_in_the_united_states): Get ERS food security in the United States - household and child food security, food insecurity, and very low food security prevalence by year, characteristic, and State, each pivoted to a wide layout
- [frontier_and_remote_area_codes](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/frontier_and_remote_area_codes): Get ERS frontier and remote (FAR) area codes - a ZIP-code geographic classification lookup at four FAR levels with grid population, land area, and population density, in a single-vintage lookup table scoped by State
- [fruit_and_tree_nuts_data](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/fruit_and_tree_nuts_data): Get ERS fruit and tree nuts data - the Fruit and Tree Nuts Yearbook area, production, price, supply, per-capita availability, and import-share tables, each pivoted to a wide layout by year
- [fruit_and_vegetable_prices](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/fruit_and_vegetable_prices): Get ERS fruit and vegetable prices - 2023 average retail price, preparation yield factor, cup-equivalent size, and average price per edible cup-equivalent, one row per commodity and marketed form
- [global_food_assessment](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/global_food_assessment): Get ERS Global Food Assessment - grain food demand, other demand, total demand, production, and the implied additional supply required to close the food gap, pivoted to a wide layout with the subregions as columns and the base year and ten-year projection horizon as rows

- [international_agricultural_productivity](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/international_agricultural_productivity): Get ERS international agricultural productivity - agricultural total factor productivity indices, output and input quantity indices, and the underlying physical output and input quantities for countries, territories, regions, income groups, and the world, pivoted to a wide layout by year
- [international_baseline_data](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/international_baseline_data): Get ERS International Baseline Data - long-term projections of area, yield, production, supply, use, and trade for grains, oilseeds, cotton, and livestock, pivoted to a wide layout with the countries and regions as columns and the crop or calendar years as rows
- [international_macroeconomic_data_set](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/international_macroeconomic_data_set): Get ERS International Macroeconomic Data Set - historical and projected real GDP, GDP per capita, GDP deflator, real GDP shares, real exchange rates, consumer price indices, and population for baseline countries and regions from 1970 through the 2035 projection horizon, pivoted to a wide layout with the countries and regions as columns and the years as rows
- [livestock_and_meat_domestic_data](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/livestock_and_meat_domestic_data): Get ERS livestock and meat domestic data - slaughter, production, weights, cold storage, supply and disappearance, and livestock and wholesale prices, each pivoted to a wide layout by attribute

- [milk_cost_of_production](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/milk_cost_of_production): Get ERS milk cost of production estimates, by state or by size of operation
- [natural_amenities_scale](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/natural_amenities_scale): Get ERS natural amenities scale - a county-level measure of the physical characteristics that make a location a desirable place to live, combining six standardized climate, topography, and water-area components into a composite amenity scale and a 1-to-7 rank, as a one-row-per-county FIPS lookup scoped by state
- [normalized_prices](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/normalized_prices): Get ERS normalized prices - national and State-level normalized prices for crops, livestock, milk, poultry, eggs, and wool, plus national prices-received and prices-paid indices, each pivoted to a wide layout with report years, index years, or States in the columns

- [poverty_area_measures](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/poverty_area_measures): Get ERS Poverty Area Measures - county- and census-tract-level poverty-area classification flags (high-poverty, extreme-poverty, persistent-poverty, and enduring-poverty), published in successive editions as a FIPS/tract lookup table scoped by edition, geography level, and state
- [price_spreads](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/reference/usda/price_spreads): Get ERS price spreads from farm to consumer - retail price versus farm value for food items and market baskets

- [Settings & Configuration](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/settings/index): Reference for OpenBB Python V5 settings: user_settings.json, system_settings.json, openbb.toml, environment variables, and the order in which each is applied.

- [Configure credentials](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/credentials): Set provider API keys for the Python Interface, the REST API, and the MCP server, and understand which value wins when a key is set in more than one place.

- [Environment variables](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/environment-variables): Set OPENBB_* variables and provider keys through the shell or .env files, when they are read, and the variables used for common tasks.

- [User Guide](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/index): Task-oriented guides for calling OpenBB commands from Python, the REST API, or the MCP server: credentials, preferences, openbb.toml, output types, parameters, warnings and errors, and environment variables.

- [Use openbb.toml](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/openbb-toml): Where openbb.toml is discovered, which processes read it, what it controls, and when to use it instead of the JSON settings files or environment variables.

- [Output types](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/output-types): Convert command results to pandas, Polars, NumPy, dictionaries, or JSON for LLM tools, per call or as a session default, and the packages each needs.

- [Configure preferences and defaults](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/preferences-and-defaults): Change user preferences for a session or permanently, choose a default provider per command, and pre-fill command parameters.

- [Pass query parameters](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/query-parameters): Find a command's parameters and pass providers, symbols, dates, choices, and provider-specific options from Python or over the REST API.

- [Handle warnings and errors](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/python/user-guide/warnings-and-errors): Read the warnings captured on each result, show, silence, or escalate them, and catch OpenBBError in Python or map REST status codes.
